definitions.gloss: public welfare; health and well-being of people
definitions.explanation: The improvement of people's health and living conditions, by the state or by an employer. Rarely used alone; it appears in compounds such as {厚生労働省|こうせいろうどうしょう} and {福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}→福利厚生：04882_fukurikousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{厚生労働省|こうせいろうどうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare announced it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{厚生|こうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{保養所|ほようじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: This company owns a resort facility for the welfare of its employees.

notes:
Found almost only in compounds; learners meet it in company benefit descriptions and in the name of the health ministry.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}→福利厚生：04882_fukurikousei⟧: employee benefits and welfare programs
- {厚生労働省|こうせいろうどうしょう}: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (often {厚労省|こうろうしょう})
- ⟦{厚生年金|こうせいねんきん}→厚生年金：31096_kouseinenkin⟧: employees' pension insurance
- {厚生施設|こうせいしせつ}: welfare facility (for employees)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{更生|こうせい}→更生：18057_kousei⟧ (rehabilitation, reform of an offender) and ⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧ (composition) share the reading; only {厚生|こうせい} means welfare
